findings.title: Unreserved duplicate-key JSON is rejected when Unicode escapes trigger inspection
findings.description: Independently reproduced at this SHA: storage_pairs applies unique before establishing reserved storage identity. Ordinary duplicate-key JSON with literal text is returned as plain, while Unicode-escaped nonreserved text raises evidence-duplicate-key. This narrow fail-closed availability limitation does not change accepted bytes, bypass PASS provenance, or affect the selected evidence.
findings.suggested_change: In a prospective compatibility correction, enforce duplicate keys for reserved storage objects while preserving ordinary nonreserved bytes; add literal/escaped parity coverage.
